topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 19 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 6 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, infraredupgradeable, upgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
